title: Taiwanese American Lawyers Association (TALA) 台美律師協會
content_html: The Taiwanese American Lawyers Association (TALA) is a community-service based legal organization serving the Southern California Taiwanese American community. It strives to provide necessary assistance and guidance to its members. The organization was founded in 1994 by Mao-Ching Huang, who rallied more than ten Taiwanese American lawyers to establish it.
